message: The other day, I decided to test our smoke alarms—just a little home safety check. I had the kids help, and we turned it into a mini fire drill with a twist: we pretended we were explorers on a mission! 🧭 It felt less like a chore and more like an adventure, and we even ended up discussing our escape plan over some hot cocoa. Who knew being prepared could be so cozy? Have you ever turned a safety check into a fun family moment?
